description: 3D Point Cloud of a railway slope - MOMIT (Multi-scale observation and monitoring of railway infrastructure threats) EU project - H2020-EU.3.4.8.3. - Grant agreement ID: 777630 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors José Luis Asensio Riquelme, Max Ruffo (Terabee). 3D point cloud of a railway trench in Lavancia-Épercy (France). The 3D point cloud has been generated from pictures obtained by means of a UAV (DJI Matrice 600 Pro) and processed using Agisoft Metashape. The 3D point cloud is composed of 110,356,682 million points containing XYZ and RGB information. Coverage: national (FR); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
